William Wollaston, The Religion of Nature Delineated.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/william-wollaston/the-religion-of-nature-delineated

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- William Wollaston, the author, died 1724.
- John Clarke, the annotator, died 1757.

First publication of the text used: 1722 (SE colophon: 'The Religion of Nature Delineated was published in 1722 by William Wollaston.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1722, before 1931. Under the United States 95-year rule, every publication of 1930 or earlier has been in the public domain since 1 January 2026 at the latest.
- Country of origin: the country of first publication does not change the result. Every person whose words are in the text died in 1757 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less.
